# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives fixes.

## Known limitation

The operator dashboard listens on every network interface and has no login, so anyone on the same network can send robot moves or reset the game. This is part of the course design and is documented in the README. Reports about it are welcome, but please do not report it as a new vulnerability.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not report security problems in public issues, discussions, or pull requests.

Report them privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/connect-4-robot/security/advisories/new).

Include:

- The affected release or commit
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept
- The impact you expect

## What happens next

The maintainer will reply in the private advisory thread. This is a finished course project maintained in spare time, so there is no guaranteed response time.
